study.question: Does finite-history within-cell age dispersion add predictive evidence beyond exchangeable_joint plus histogram and conditional within-bin age means, and does localization matter beyond pooled within-bin dispersion and duplicated mean readout capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: r18 continuous compact evidence (AUC0.62197269) lost to duplicate histogram (0.62216595); r19 continuous fusion (0.62227116) lost to duplicate (0.62250866) and zero (0.62229183). r20 centered fine-age input (0.62259365) exceeded matched histogram (0.62232134) and zero (0.62212176). r21 conditional means (0.62263160) exceeded marginal (0.62241961) and histogram (0.62225372), but exceeded observed means by only0.00002828; this does not establish subtraction as the mechanism. Incumbent code retains fine age means but no explicit within-cell fine-age variance. Grouped mean and count summaries can agree for histories with different dispersion. A small additional population-variance readout may recover compact-source information lost by broad continuous fusion. Strong prediction: an observed or conditional variance candidate exceeds both frozen source bests, the incumbent, the pooled-variance and duplicate-mean controls; conditional>observed is separately required for centering/localization claims. These are unverified hypotheses, not claims of novelty or success.

nearest_work.difference: Retain this whole model; append one matched third readout. Current scalar evidence uses fine-age conditional means, not variance.

Inherits motivation from count/freshness/second-moment source, but measures centered fine-age dispersion inside frozen coarse bins and separates local from pooled within-cell dispersion. Not a new claim for moment statistics in general.

DIN describes target-conditioned weighted pooling and interest intensity. The inherited task reference uses softmax attention and field substitutions, not exact DIN. This test adds deterministic per-cell dispersion and retains current shallow heads; no learned attention/query change.
README confirms only category/brand/action histories and no item IDs. Use those fields only; publisher full text unavailable, so no detailed DMR reproduction or priority claim.

inherited_components: Entire g0-r0021-bin_conditional model and configuration; old constructor prefix and method bodies preserved except forward/diagnostics rename
Exchangeable identity/context/repeat/overlap tables, match/action/coarse-age histogram, fixed log2-age embeddings
First histogram residual, second conditional-mean residual, context modulation and zero-final-weight residual principle
No checkpoint warm start; all weights trained from scratch
study.proposed_difference: Append a bias-free64->32 ReLU->1 residual with a68->32 RMS/tanh context gate (4256 parameters), after all incumbent allocations. For each of64 match-group/action/coarse-age cells, keep frozen fraction f in[0,1] and h=log1p(n)/log129. Compute finite-history population variance v_c=mean((f-mean_c)^2) by centered deviations; empty and singleton v_c=0. Define pooled within-cell variance vbar_b=sum_c(n_c*v_c)/sum_c(n_c), pooling match/action axes inside this impression and bin, explicitly excluding between-cell mean dispersion. Four inputs: O=4*h*v_c; G=4*h*vbar_b; R=O-G; M=existing conditional-mean map. Factor4 comes from variance bound1/4, not calibration. O=R+G; empty cells zero. All variants compute every alternative and differ only by selection. This is a controlled local second-moment test, not verified novelty.
predictions: At least one variance candidate has full-population validation AUC above0.6226315963357782 and both frozen source bests0.6218776973444221/0.6205915285296155, and exceeds both fresh matched active controls. Report Logloss separately, including disagreement.

Conditional variance>marginal and duplicate mean would support localized dispersion access provisionally; conditional>observed would additionally support removing pooled variance. Observed-only success supports variance access but not centering.

A constructed paired-history witness keeps cell means/counts, global age multiset, log2 buckets and inherited logits approximately fixed, while swapping distinct within-cell spreads; O and R change, G and M agree. This verifies access only.

Host parameter count expected17200339 total,17078688 embeddings,121651 dense; appended4256 equal across variants. Additional passes increase cost; no efficiency claim without host measured training/inference cost.

Predeclare existing history-length bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 as exploratory diagnostics, retaining sample/positive/negative counts from host. r21 conditional vs observed difference is0.00008702 AUC in>64 (3026583 samples,151372positive,2875211negative), but negative in17-64 (157391,6311positive,151080negative). Empty-history differences can arise through jointly trained shared parameters despite zero history readout; do not treat them as direct history mechanism evidence. Global AUC remains selection criterion; small slices and post-hoc bins do not confirm a mechanism.
falsifiers: No variance candidate exceeds the incumbent and duplicate-mean control: complementary predictive dispersion remains unsupported.
Gain reproduced by marginal pooled dispersion: evidence does not identify local association; conditional<=observed fails the centering claim.
Nonzero witness control gaps beyond float32 rounding, oracle/invariance failures, finite-logit failures, or unexpected parameter mismatch invalidate interpretation pending correction.
One-seed success disappearing in paired repetitions or cost parity leaves repeatability/efficiency unsupported. A failed implementation does not refute dispersion generally.
alternative_explanations: r21 mean gain may be seed/selection noise; reuse of validation across many rounds creates optimistic selection.
Additional readout capacity, initialization or nonlinear optimization may explain a gain; duplicate-mean arm tests this.
Count-dependent finite-history variance reflects occupancy and sparsity rather than behavioral bursts; marginal variance and count/histogram retained, and no population variance inference is claimed.
Variance scale, higher-order moments, mean-dispersion coupling and optimization condition numbers remain confounded; range scaling does not equalize empirical variance.
Coarse-bin centering and transformed ages can encode arbitrary representation choices. No benefit on the supplied history implies no claim about unavailable older histories or item identities.
Static user/ad snapshot as-of dates are undocumented; no production point-in-time or cross-task transfer conclusion.

Variance candidate selection across two arms and many prior rounds adds selection optimism; report every arm, including failures, and compare paired repeated outcomes rather than the best seed. No user-cluster interval is available in this phase unless host supplies one.
